metadata.description: Provide a prefix (max 10 characters, unique at tenant-scope) for the Management Group hierarchy and other resources created as part of the Azure landing zone deployment.
Determines whether to create a new root Management Group or deploy to existing. If not specified, will default to true.

Specifies the parent management group ID when creating a new root management group or the management group ID of an existing root management group. If not specified, will default to the "Tenant Root Group".
Determines whether to deploy all resources, or just the management group hierarchy. This settings allows the template to be deployed by identities with limited permissions in the target tenant.
The customer usage identifier used for telemetry purposes. The default value of False enables telemetry. The value of True disables telemetry.

If 'Yes' is selected when also adding a subscription for management, ARM will assign two policies to enable auditing in your environment, into the Log Analytics workspace for platform monitoring. If 'No', it will be ignored.
Provide the subscription ID of an existing, empty subscription you want to dedicate for management. If you don't want to bring a subscription, leave this parameter empty as is.

If 'Yes' is selected when also adding a subscription for management, ARM will assign two policies to enable auditing in your environment, into the Log Analytics workspace for platform monitoring. If 'No', it will be ignored.
